pro_course_detail.title: IELTS or TOEFL Speaking Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Please choose a class based on the descriptions under the IELTS or TOEFL sections below.

IELTS:
This class is a simulation of the IELTS speaking test (General or Academic).  We will do this class as if we were at a testing center.  I designed the class in a similar format to the actual speaking test with three parts (timed) and a cue-card topic. 

Classes: 
• 30-minute class includes one (1) test simulation (one cue-card topic) and feedback
• 45-minute class includes two (2) test simulations (two cue-card topics) and feedback
• 60-minute class includes three (3) test simulations (three cue-card topics) and feedback
• Includes estimate of your speaking score based on the IELTS band scale (1-9)

TOEFL:
This class is a simulation of the TOEFL speaking task 1 question.  These questions will be in one of the following three formats: agree/disagree; paired-choice; or good idea.  I will ask you a question and you will have 15 seconds to prepare and then 45 seconds to answer the question.

Classes:
• 30-minute class includes 10 to 20 questions and feedback
• 45-minute class includes 15 to 30 questions and feedback
• 60-minute class includes 20 to 40 questions and  feedback

Additionally, I can help you prepare for the Integrated Speaking Task questions.

I have also flown J-3 Cubs and Cessna 152s for fun and have over 40 hours logged in these aircraft.  

With these skills I hope to teach my students both aviation and military terminology, acronyms, and even military jargon.  

I can also guide you on how to get your Private Pilot License (PPL).  Flying is one of the best experiences of my life and I would love to share it with you! Homework is mandatory.

pro_course_detail.description:
❗️👀 This class isn't everyone's cup of tea! 
This class is great for those feel stagnant and want to grow and challenge themselves. 
Language is simply repetition and a culmination of your own speaking habits, which is why it may feel like you're stuck or plateaued because you need someone to challenge and bring out a different side to you.

💡 Come with a topic prepared and I'll bring out the best of your abilities while introducing new words/phrases!
💡 Most of my students want to reach native fluency, so I do encourage you to repeat any corrected sentences/phrases as it will only help cement what you've learned.
💡 After class I'll send you a summary PDF of what we went over PLUS other phrases that I know you'll find useful.

Being fluent in a language requires a lot of listening and even more interacting. 
Independent study can only go so far but eventually everyone hits a dead end. 
I hope that you find a teacher that suits YOU! Communicate with each other to find that sweet spot of learning and growing. I say this a lot but "slow and steady wins the race", except this isn't race however it does take time, time and more time.

I believe that studying phrasal verbs is one of the most useful and quick ways to improve, although the most important thing to do is study just a little bit everyday!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I teach through conversation, asking you questions and challenging you to answer and then correcting you on the spot. We can practice new phrasal verbs or idioms that native speakers actually use, imagine learning 4-5 new phrases every lesson. 

I also use articles for some students if they would like to focus more on reading or pronunciation practice. Feel free to send me a message~ 加油加油！

course_info.trial_description: In our trail lesson we will discuss the best ways we can work together to improve your English level. We can work on some common phrases and practical verbs that might benefit your everyday spoken English. I am interested to hear why you want to learn English and how I may best help you! Hope to see you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Fluency
pro_course_detail.description: Welcome to my lessons! We will focus on conversation and speaking practice. At the same time we will work on improving your pronunciation and listening. I will try to get a feel for your current language ability and then push you a bit so that you will challenge yourself a bit, that's how you improve after all!
